# 虚境封印 / Shroud Seal

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C6 巨兽与城邦 / Leviathans & enclaves
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:14854-14889`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt (on_megastructure_built → 5375)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

建成巨型建筑“虚境封印”时（on_megastructure_built），若与行虚者城邦有通讯、不是灵督起源且此前未被警告。

On completing a Shroud Seal megastructure (on_megastructure_built), if in contact with the Shroudwalker Enclave, not of the Mindwardens origin and not warned before.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

行虚者城邦斥责我们：这些封印令最明亮的心灵痛苦，要求立即停止建造，否则断绝往来。行虚者对我们的信任下降。

The Shroudwalker Enclave rebukes us: the seals pain the most radiant minds; stop building them or it will cut ties. Shroudwalker trust drops.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项“再会了”。

Only option: "Goodbye".

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

原标题为空（继承行虚者菜单窗口），故用巨型建筑原名“虚境封印”作标题。分类改为 C6：它是行虚者城邦对玩家行为的反应，建议 C6 的行虚者城邦故事链接到此卡。

The title is empty (inherited from the Shroudwalker menu window), so the megastructure name "Shroud Seal" is used. Category changed to C6: it is the Shroudwalker Enclave's reaction; the C6 Shroudwalker story may link here.
